# IM Tri Tracker

> IM Tri Tracker is a triathlon results app for iPhone and Android. Search your name, see swim, T1, bike, T2 and run splits ranked within each race. No account.

## App

- [Triathlon Results App, Ranked by Split | IM Tri Tracker](https://jackwallner.com/ios/ironman/index.html.md): IM Tri Tracker is a triathlon results app for iPhone and Android. Search your name, see swim, T1, bike, T2 and run splits ranked within each race. No account.
